'''Talsa''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamuir IV]]. The world had bountiful talsa [[Forest/Legends|forests]], and the trees produced a dark and extremely dense wood that was used scuplting, making furniture, and even manufacturing weapons.<ref name="LE" />
